title: Calendar planner
idea: Calendar planner: Time grid and event inspector share a clear timezone
audience: People who need to schedule within a desktop surface.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic spatial layout through its schedule priority and explicit commitment contract: Conflicts and timezone changes are reviewed before saving
navigation: Calendar planner keeps the current schedule context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Time grid and event inspector share a clear timezone
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to schedule; time conflicts drive decisions
composition.priority: Conflicts and timezone changes are reviewed before saving

imagery.role: Support the actual schedule context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Provide agenda alternative to compressed week columns
Respect window resizing, keyboard navigation and persistent document/workspace context.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the calendar planner structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no schedule content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Conflicts and timezone changes are reviewed before saving
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized schedule content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Conflicts and timezone changes are reviewed before saving
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active schedule context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure representative large documents/collections and resize interaction on target OS.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
